text: {"lessons":["My account fell from NT$104,088 to NT$96,539 despite making no trades; doing nothing avoids impulsive decisions, but it does not remove investment risk.","These few months of gains and losses do not predict what comes next, so I should not react to recent price moves alone.","At each deliberate review, I should assess future prospects and diversification—not my average cost or the pain or pleasure of realizing a loss or gain."]}
